text: I think you'll really enjoy this recipe, Now This is Alice Springs Chicken. It features chicken, which is a staple in your cooking preferences, and has a rich flavor profile with ingredients like Dijon mustard, honey, and Worcestershire sauce, which are all commonly used in recipes you've liked in the past. The addition of mushrooms and bacon also adds a savory element that you tend to appreciate. While it does take a bit longer to prepare, I think the end result will be worth the extra time.
